events.title: We're on Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: We're on a Steam Next Fest!I'm happy to announce that you can play the Outpost Simulator demo during Steam Next Fest! The demo has been out for a while now, and I've seen how much you've enjoyed it. I've taken every review, discussion topic, and social media comment into consideration, and they've helped shape the game. Your feedback matters, so I'd love to hear more! It means a lot to me.From the bottom of my heart: thank you.Remember to wishlist our game! We'll see you soon with more updates!

events.title: Update / Patch Notes Version 1.3.4
events.summary: Fixed bugs that could cause the game to freeze.Added an in-game map with zoom functionality and explored-area tracking.Added a minimap for easier navigation.Added a menu to switch between your backpack, objectives, and other panels.Fixed a crash when tents were placed too close together.Fixed a crash when launching the game through Steam.Fixed freezes while saving and while loading a large base.Fixed cases where you could not move or look around after closing a menu.

events.title: Update / Patch Notes Version 1.3.1
events.summary: Version 1.3.1 – Improvements & FixesFixed numerous issues that could cause crashes and freezes.Fixed a turret firing issue.
